text: Author-study iteration 0 brief: the accepted research review (iteration 1) left RES-005 (advisory) and RES-006 (accepted), which the packet does not carry; the brief named that review's result as context to be weighed, not followed, with the rule that the quoted source governs over a sealed gloss. The brief also listed the register rules that guidance/editorial.md and the three-document profile already state and on which the cold study reviews of Claude runs 66 and 67 failed (study links credited to texts, narrated joining, roll calls, inference labels, restating or maxim closers, over-reading or truncating quotations, reported views as own, date prose about the generated page, overcorrection in revision). No content conclusion was supplied.
